node.label: Starry sky appearance on hepatic sonography
node.definition: An abnormal echotexture visible in liver ultrasound manifesting as a diffuse hyperechoic liver echotexture with multiple, small hypoechoic lesions. The appearance is said to resemble a starry sky (multiple white spots on a dark background).

evidence.snippet: Multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 2: Starry sky appearance on hepatic sonography (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
